annotation_provenance: Assistant-authored synthetic examples, reviewed against the extraction contract, raw text spans and stored catalogue. No independent human/native-speaker review or inter-annotator agreement is claimed.
split_policy: 40 development and 40 held-out examples; 10 per language group per split; each contains 32 single-turn and 8 contextual follow-up examples. Held-out annotations were read for authoring and integrity validation only; no held-out inference or backend evaluation in this checkpoint.
limitations: Synthetic, small, single-author dataset; not population-representative.
Language groups share domain terminology and some scenario structures; this is not an independently sourced external benchmark.
Conversation targets describe desired functionality; the current API has no free-text session context.
Future annotation corrections require a new version and disclosed changes, not silent edits after model evaluation.

annotation_revisions.reason: Pre-live annotation review: add explicit form coverage in each development language group; annotate form words in held-out packaging follow-ups and sachet presentation. No held-out inference or backend execution was used for these corrections.
